description: Source code for Lua environment management in lighttpd server, including functions for getting, setting, unsetting, and managing environment variables via Lua.

methods.name: lua_environment_get
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable value from Lua stack.

methods.name: lua_environment_set
methods.description: Sets environment variable from Lua stack.

methods.name: lua_environment_weak_set
methods.description: Inserts environment variable with weak reference.

methods.name: lua_environment_pairs
methods.description: Returns key-value pairs of environment variables.

methods.name: lua_push_environment_metatable
methods.description: Pushes environment metatable onto Lua stack.

methods.name: li_lua_get_environment
methods.description: Retrieves environment object from Lua userdata.

methods.name: li_lua_push_environment
methods.description: Pushes environment object onto Lua stack as userdata.
